itineraries.title: Five days from Dubrovnik to the Elaphiti and Mljet
itineraries.intro: Dubrovnik’s walls, the stone villages of the Elaphiti and Mljet’s salt lakes.

days.note: Board in Gruž; the walls at dusk.
The largest of the Elaphiti islands: olive groves, a fjord-like bay and few visitors.
The national park and the salt lakes.
Board beneath the walls; walk them in the evening once the day visitors have gone.

itineraries.title: Seven days from Dubrovnik to Trogir
itineraries.intro: Ocean Independence’s classic Dalmatian week: Mljet, Korčula, Vis, Hvar and Trogir.

days.note: Board beneath the walls; walk them in the evening once the day visitors have gone.
The national park’s saltwater lakes and the monastery on its islet.
Marco Polo’s walled town and the Moreška sword dance; wine at Lumbarda.
The furthest inhabited island: Stiniva cove and the Blue Cave on Biševo.
Zlatni Rat, the shifting spit of white pebbles, and the stone town behind it.
The island town within its walls, a UNESCO site; disembark in the morning.
